00048 VoicerBaseUGenInternal::VoicerBaseUGenInternal(const int numChannels, const int numVoices, const bool forcedSteal) throw()
00049 : SpawnBaseUGenInternal(0, numChannels, 0),
00050  numVoices_(numVoices),
00051  stealMode_(StealOldest),
00052  forcedSteal_(forcedSteal),
00053  ageCounter(0)
00054 {
00055  ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00056  ugen_assert(numVoices >= 0);
00057 }

00059 void VoicerBaseUGenInternal::sendMidiNote(const int midiChannel, 
00060             const int midiNote,
00061             const int velocity) throw()
00062 {
00063  const int userData = createUserData(midiChannel, midiNote);
00064  
00065  ugen_assert(userData != UGen::defaultUserData);
00066  ugen_assert(velocity >= 0);
00067 
00068  if(velocity > 0)
00069  {
00070   if(numVoices_ > 0)
00071   {
00072    const int voicesUsed = countNonstealingVoices();
00073    if(voicesUsed >= numVoices_)
00074    {
00075     UGen stealee = chooseStealee();
00076      
00077     if(stealee.isNotNull())
00078     {
00079      stealee.userData = stealingUserData;
00080      stealee.steal(forcedSteal_);
00081     }
00082    }
00083   }
00084   
00085   // stop double notes, AU lab was sending two ons but only one off 
00086   // stealNote(midiChannel, midiNote, false, true);  // let's only do this in the Juce version..
00087   
00088   UGen newEvent = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++, midiChannel, midiNote, velocity);
00089   newEvent.userData = userData;
00090 //  events <<= newEvent;
00091 //  mixer = Mix(&events, false);
00092   events.add(newEvent);
00093   events.removeNulls();
00094  }
00095  else
00096  {
00097   UGen releasee = chooseReleasee(midiChannel, midiNote);
00098   
00099   if(releasee.isNotNull())
00100   {
00101    //releasee.userData = UGen::defaultUserData; // need to rethink why I really wanted to do this
00102    releasee.release();
00103   }
00104  }
00105 }

00107 bool VoicerBaseUGenInternal::stealNote(const int midiChannel, 
00108             const int midiNote, 
00109             const bool forcedSteal,
00110             const bool stealAll) throw()
00111 {
00112  const int userData = createUserData(midiChannel, midiNote);
00113  bool didSteal = false;
00114  
00115  for(int i = 0; i < events.size(); i++)
00116  {
00117   UGen& event = events[i];
00118   if(event.userData == userData)
00119   {
00120    event.userData = stealingUserData;
00121    event.steal(forcedSteal);
00122    if(stealAll)
00123     didSteal = true;
00124    else
00125     return true;
00126   }
00127  }
00128  
00129  return didSteal;
00130 }

00132 int VoicerBaseUGenInternal::countNonstealingVoices() const throw()
00133 {
00134  const int numEvents = events.size();
00135  int nonStealingVoices = 0;
00136  
00137  for(int i = 0; i < numEvents; i++)
00138  {
00139   if(events[i].userData != stealingUserData)
00140    nonStealingVoices++;
00141  }
00142  
00143  return nonStealingVoices;
00144 }

00146 const UGen& VoicerBaseUGenInternal::chooseStealee() throw()
00147 {
00148  // could use different methods in here to select the voice to steal
00149  
00150  const int numEvents = events.size();
00151  
00152  for(int i = 0; i < numEvents; i++)
00153  {
00154   UGen& stealee = events[i];
00155   if(stealee.userData != stealingUserData && stealee.isNotNull())
00156    return stealee;
00157  }
00158  
00159  return UGen::getNull();
00160 }

00162 const UGen& VoicerBaseUGenInternal::chooseReleasee(const int midiChannel, const int midiNote) throw()
00163 {
00164  ugen_assert(midiChannel == char(midiChannel));
00165  ugen_assert(midiNote == char(midiNote));
00166 
00167  const int numEvents = events.size();
00168  
00169  for(int i = numEvents-1; i >= 0; i--) // release in reverse ?
00170  {
00171   UGen& releasee = events[i];
00172   VoicerUserDataStruct data = getUserData(releasee.userData);
00173   if((data.midiChannel == midiChannel)
00174      && (data.midiNote == midiNote) 
00175      // && (releasee.isReleasing() == false // something like this would be useful but tricky to implement
00176      )
00177   {
00178    return releasee;
00179   }
00180  }
00181  
00182  return UGen::getNull();
00183 }

00185 int VoicerBaseUGenInternal::createUserData(const int midiChannel, const int midiNote) throw()
00186 {
00187  ugen_assert(midiChannel == char(midiChannel));
00188  ugen_assert(midiNote == char(midiNote));
00189 
00190  VoicerUserDataUnion data;
00191  
00192  data.i = 0;
00193  data.s.midiChannel = midiChannel;
00194  data.s.midiNote = midiNote;
00195  
00196  return data.i;
